scientific_integrity: The full moving-family proof uses exact invariant-line integration, sphere disintegration and dominated convergence. Finite quadrature is supplementary; no independent validation was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Fixed hard spectral gaps and finite dimension; asymptotic locally uniform only over bounded soft gap ratios. Earlier exact finite-threshold integral is acknowledged, and scientific priority for the explicit boundary-layer law is provisional.
title: A universal spectral-merger crossover for longest random chords of ellipsoids
